perspective:
Angela Hwang has access to the following:

- She knows she and Kevin Flores have been friends since high school and often confide in each other about personal and professional lives.
- She invited Kevin to coffee and observed/heard him say he was “alright,” just dealing with the usual grind at work.
- She told Kevin she was worried he seemed unhappy with his job; he told her he was not happy, felt stuck and unfulfilled, and was just going through the motions.
- Kevin told her he had thought about changing jobs/careers but did not know where to start and felt overwhelmed.
- Angela offered to figure out options with him; Kevin agreed and thanked her.
- Angela found job openings and a career counseling service and shared them with Kevin. Kevin thanked her for going all out.
- Kevin told her he had been thinking a lot and was interested in something more creative, possibly design or architecture.
- Angela encouraged him to check the resources; Kevin said he would and thanked her.
- Angela believed Kevin was hesitant about a career change and felt frustrated/worried. She arranged a meeting with a career coach.
- She told Kevin she believed in him and had arranged the coach. Kevin said she did not have to, appreciated it, but was not sure he was ready.
- Angela encouraged him that a push and the coach could help. Kevin agreed to give it a shot and thanked her.
- Angela believed Kevin was making progress, felt proud/relieved, and checked in.
- Kevin told her the career coach was helpful, he had started online design courses, and he felt more confident.
- Angela said she was proud and asked if she could help. Kevin said just knowing she was there was enough.
- Angela promised to always be there; Kevin thanked her.
- Angela believed Kevin had successfully transitioned to a new career, felt happy/satisfied, and organized a small celebration party.
- She told Kevin about the party and that he deserved it. Kevin thanked her and said it meant a lot.
- Kevin told her he was grateful and could not have done it without her. Angela said he did the hard work and invited him to enjoy the party; Kevin agreed.
